split_policy: Three nonoverlapping development windows; two separately reserved holdout windows. No candidate selection/tuning on holdout model/enhancement outcomes.
holdout_blindness: NOT_BLIND: anchor pixels and short bursts were already inspected in Phase1; current raw temporal preview is sample planning only, not enhancement/model evaluation.
limitations: Window lengths are experiment budgets; no complete physical passage is asserted by these ranges.
Beginning is left-censored and end is right-censored by file boundaries.
A vehicle identity across split boundaries cannot be established without temporal/manual evidence; do not label windows ground truth.
Index/FPS timing is estimated; authoritative source PTS and variable-frame-rate status remain unknown.
Sparse development samples support photometric/detection screening only; tracking/counting requires actual continuous frames plus approved geometry.
